verdict.rationale: IRCC is a government immigration department and services portal (work permits, visas, processing times, application status). User-defined event-triggered automation rules are a workflow-automation capability outside this product category, so the story is a category error rather than an unmet capability. Nothing in the evidence shows IRCC offering anything of this kind.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
